source: Newsmeter / Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu / Times of India
bullets_en: 13 illegal motors seized in Shamshabad: HMWSSB moves to protect drinking water supply.
Farmer Rides Motorbike Through Dry Field To Protest Water Shortage, Power Cuts.
NCP leader challenges Sunetra Pawar’s decision to appoint a new national chief spokesperson.
Bolsonaro declares himself Brazil’s ‘true president’, vows to lead opposition from US.
bullets_ur: Shamshabad mein 13 ghair qanooni motors zabt: HMWSSB ka peenay ke pani ki farahmi bachane ke liye iqdaam.
Kisan ne pani ki kami aur bijli ki load shedding ke khilaf sookhe khet mein motorbike chala di.
NCP leader ne naye national chief spokesperson ki taiynti ka Sunetra Pawar ka faisla chalanth kar diya.
Bolsonaro ne khud ko Brazil ka "sacha sadar" qarar de diya, America se opposition ki qayadat ka azm.
